name: code-simplifier
description: 代码精简工具包：simplify 子智能体与 /simplify 命令，对最近改动的代码做保功能重构——降低嵌套、消除冗余、统一项目规范，改完自检编译与测试。

description_i18n.en: Code simplification toolkit: a simplify subagent plus a /simplify command that refines recently modified code — flattening nesting, removing redundancy, applying project standards — while preserving all functionality, with self-checks after edits.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 代码精简工具包：simplify 子智能体与 /simplify 命令，对最近改动的代码做保功能重构——降低嵌套、消除冗余、统一项目规范，改完自检编译与测试。
